qa_pairs.question: What transmission model is shown in this assembly drawing?
qa_pairs.answer: This is an assembly drawing of shift parts for the Getrag 260 five speed overdrive manual transmission.

qa_pairs.question: What component is identified by callout number 1?
qa_pairs.answer: Callout number 1 identifies the selector rod for 1st/2nd gear.

qa_pairs.question: Which selector fork is used for reverse and 5th gear operation?
qa_pairs.answer: According to the legend, callout number 7 shows the selector rod for reverse/5th gear.

qa_pairs.question: What is the function of component number 4 in this transmission?
qa_pairs.answer: Component number 4 is identified as the dog, which is used in gear engagement.

qa_pairs.question: Where is the operating lever located in this assembly?
qa_pairs.answer: The operating lever is identified as callout number 12 and is located at the top right portion of the transmission assembly.

qa_pairs.question: What components make up the 3rd/4th gear selection system?
qa_pairs.answer: The 3rd/4th gear selection system consists of the selector fork (callout 2) and selector rod (callout 3) for 3rd/4th gear.

qa_pairs.question: Which callout number identifies the selector arm component?
qa_pairs.answer: Callout number 10 identifies the selector arm component.

qa_pairs.question: What is the reference number shown at the bottom right of this diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: The reference number shown at the bottom right is G 30 23 302.
